To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

GPER achieves significant power savings in sensor networks, and that probabilistic multipath geographic routing algorithms can provide additional power saving in non-uniformly communicating sensor networks.

(1) GPER is a power efficient geographic routing protocol for sensor networks; (2) probabilistic multipath geographic routing algorithms provide a good alternative to traditional deterministic algorithms.
